gap_note: No public price index exists. These are sold at regional auctions (South Africa/Lesotho wool and mohair growers' associations); prices are set per-lot at auction and reported by the auction houses themselves, not published as a continuous series a free API could expose.

No public spot price exists. Diamonds are graded and priced per-stone (cut, clarity, colour, carat all vary), not a fungible commodity traded on an exchange the way gold or oil are -- there is no equivalent of a 'diamond price per ounce' to track.
